About Me

Detail-Driven, Client-Focused

💼 Accounting & Finance
🤝 Customer Relations
✅ Compliance & Audit

I'm Aliou Garga Aboubikr — a Finance & Administrative Assistant and Customer Relations professional with 3+ years of experience supporting banking, utilities, logistics and remote finance operations across Cameroon and France.

I'm skilled in cash and accrual accounting, month-end close, bank reconciliation, invoice and expense processing, budget forecasting, client account management, and regulatory compliance (BEAC/COBAC). I maintain accurate financial records under OHADA and IFRS-aligned practices, and I have a proven track record resolving client billing inquiries at a 90%+ resolution rate.

I'm comfortable working remotely across time zones with ERP and cloud finance platforms (SAP, Qonto, Pennylane), and I'm currently completing a Master's in Accounting, Control and Audit. Alongside my core finance and admin work, I also founded CvatsPro.com and build websites as an additional skill — a bonus that reflects the same attention to detail I bring to every role.
